# faust-ui 1.1.19 (vendored)

The user interface the Faust tools build from a DSP's JSON description:
`dist/esm/index.js` and `dist/esm/index.css` of the npm package
`@shren/faust-ui` 1.1.19 (author Fr0stbyteR, Shihong Ren;
https://github.com/Fr0stbyteR/faust-ui), as faustwasm copies it into its PWAs,
the last source-map comments removed.

License: GPL-3.0-or-later (the package's `license` field). It is used only by
the phone apps the page builds with the "faust-ui interface" option
(web/pwa.js, web/phone/phone.js); an app built with it carries this file and is
distributed under the GPL-3.0-or-later.
